config.design: Add a leading space to every unprefixed prompt, aligning body token IDs across prefix presence. Repeat all H608 trace/removal sites without selection. Trace four-condition interaction at final-position attention/MLP writes and residuals. On combined prefix+lowercase prompt subtract each native write interaction separately before MLP11 input: attention/MLP0-10 and attention11. Compare one seeded norm-matched random subtraction per site and identity run. All23 sites predeclared, no ranking-based filtering.
config.scope: Removing interaction at a write is not removing its local generation: inherited interaction can appear in the write. Only final position intervened, other positions remain live. Target is native normalized MLP11 input interaction, not H607 injected-signal response. Full output KL is relative to unmodified combined prompt.
